Title: Microsoft Operations Management Suite releases Update Management

Body.Content:
With the Update Management solution, Microsoft Operations Management Suite helps customers keep IT systems updated without any unplanned application downtime.

Customers can get time estimates and optimized sequences of updates for their Windows Server and Linux systems to improve application availability and their service-level agreement (SLA). They can integrate System Center Configuration Manager, Windows Server Update Services, and third-party systems for orchestrated update runs from the cloud.

Customers can start using the Update Management solution now. For more information, please visit the Get started with Operations Management Suite page.
